name: habanera-bandoneon-card-sharp
style: instrumental, 15-second cue, slow sly tango-habanera duet, 1930s smoke-room parlour: lone bandoneon breathing a slinky, sidelong melody over an upright piano limping the dotted habanera bass, invented tune, close dry room. Card riffles and a small counter-bell ting fall on the offbeats like percussion. At 7 seconds one hard bandoneon sforzando stab and a staccato low piano cluster, then dead silence. Last four seconds: a single thin bandoneon note held unresolved, a velvet curtain swishing open, near-empty air. no vocals
